cta.picker: Or look around a demo event first

exit.message: The demo event, its shifts and everything you booked in it are deleted straight away. None of it can be brought back.
exit.title: End the demo?

expired.message: Demo events only last an hour, and yours has just been deleted along with everything in it. You can try a fresh one, or create a real account and keep what you plan.
expired.title: Your demo has ended

helper.description: Book yourself into shifts, say when you are free, and see what you have signed up for.
helper.title: As a helper

startDialog.intro: We'll set up an example event for you, with tasks, shifts and a few teammates, and take you straight to it. Nothing in it is real, and it is all deleted after an hour.

manager.description: Plan the tasks and shifts, see which places are still open, and handle invitations and requests to join.
manager.title: As an organiser

startDialog.question: Which side would you like to see?
startDialog.signedInWarning: Starting the demo signs you out of your account. Your own events stay as they are, and you can sign back in whenever you like.
startDialog.title: Look around a demo event

helper.body: You are at Riverside Summer Festival, a village festival over three weekends, run entirely by volunteers. You are one of the helpers: you can take shifts, hand them back, and say when you have time.

manager.body: You are running Riverside Summer Festival, a village festival over three weekends, run entirely by volunteers. You describe the jobs, wirksam turns them into shifts, and you can see where people are still missing.

welcome.playground: Try anything you like. The event is yours alone, and nobody else can see it. When the timer at the top runs out, it is deleted along with everything you did in it.
welcome.question: Shall I show you round first?
welcome.title: Welcome to your demo
